description: This file contains CMake functions for regex matching and replacement, including 'string_take_regex' and 'string_take_regex_replace', with examples and comments explaining their behavior and limitations.

methods.name: string_take_regex
methods.description: Matches a regex at the beginning of a string variable, returns the match, and shortens the input string.

methods.name: string_take_regex_replace
methods.description: Uses 'string_take_regex' to match a pattern and then replaces it with a specified string, updating the input variable.
